title: The one-parameter fix that proves the confidence was decorative
question: The one-parameter fix that proves the confidence was decorative
hook: Deep networks say "99%" when they should say "85%" — and a single learned number fixes it without changing a single decision.
core_idea: Temperature scaling divides the logits by T before softmax, softening stated confidence while leaving the ranking untouched — direct proof that correctness and confidence were separable all along.
visual_object: a softmax bar chart softening as a temperature dial turns
exclusions: no cross-entropy training analysis, no Platt/isotonic comparison, no distribution-shift caveat beyond one closing line
